Amazon Refund Delay Support Policy
Product: Amazon Scenario: Refund Delay
Demo policy document created for testing an AI customer-support knowledge base. This is sample content, not an official
company policy.
Purpose
Use this guidance when a customer says a refund is pending, delayed, not credited, or missing after a
return or cancellation.
Verification Checklist
Step
Guidance
1
Confirm the order ID, refund reference, payment method, and date on which the
return or cancellation was completed.
2
Check whether the returned item has passed warehouse verification or whether the
cancellation refund has been initiated.
3
Check whether the refund is marked as initiated, processed, failed, reversed, or
pending.
Customer Guidance
Explain the current refund status clearly. Do not promise an exact credit date unless the system
provides one.

chunks.content:

Customer Guidance
Explain the current refund status clearly. Do not promise an exact credit date unless the system
provides one. If the refund is processed but not visible, ask the customer to verify the original payment
method and allow the applicable banking time.
Escalation
Escalate when the refund has exceeded the stated processing window, the transaction shows failed or
reversed, or the customer has already contacted support multiple times without resolution.
Recommended Agent Response
Acknowledge the delay, confirm that you will verify the refund reference and payment method, provide
the next step, and avoid repeating a generic waiting message.

Amazon Wrong or Damaged Item Support Policy
Product: Amazon Scenario: Wrong Product / Damaged Product
Demo policy document created for testing an AI customer-support knowledge base. This is sample content, not an official
company policy.
Purpose
Use this guidance when the delivered item is different from the order, incomplete, broken, cracked,
defective, or damaged in transit.
Evidence and Verification
Step
Guidance
1
Confirm the order ID, ordered product, received product, and delivery date.
2
Ask for photos only when required by the support process.
3
Check whether replacement, return, or refund is available for the item.
Resolution Options
Offer only the options supported by the order status and item category. Clearly explain whether pickup,
replacement shipment, or refund verification is required.
